title: Ngalu nguu Sankii Les Mawnikinaare
intro: Miijo-ɗee daraade yeeso tuubaaji jawdi keewɗi haa ɓurti, tawa ko jolnude tan coktirgal ina usta fedde yimɓe tiiɗɓe. E nder maa, daande ina ɗaɓɓi neɗɗaagal e siftorde, kono mawnikinaare ina ɓeydoo yettude. Hol ko kewata so bounty wontii jarribo, mawnikinaare siifi batte mum?
clues: Miɗo jeyaa e yimɓe Muusaa, tee mi tooñii ɓe.
Mi rokkaama ngalu keewngu haa heewi, haa coktirgal mum ina teddina fedde worɓe tiiɗɓe.
Mi wasiyiima leñol am hoto mi welto e ɗaɓɓude laakara tawa mi yejjitaani geɗal am e aduna.
Miɗo wiya ko njogiimi koo rokkaama tan ko ganndal ngal njogiimi.
Miɗo ƴakka yeeso leñol am e mbaydi, yiɗɓe nguurndam aduna ina njiɗi ko nanndi e ko njogiimi koo.
Mi ɓuuɓnaama e leydi wondude e hoɗorde am, hay gooto waawaa wallude mi, mi waawaa kadi wallude hoore am.

arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِۦ وَبِدَارِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ مِن فِئَةٍۢ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنتَصِرِينَ
verse: And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves. (28:81)
